purpose: Candidates that were considered and rejected/refuted during the audit. Preserved to prevent re-investigation.

rejected.title: Automated CI gate required for beta admit
rejected.reason_for_rejection: Out of scope for this audit. CI activation is owned by Infosec UNIT-012 (AUXILIARY, AUTH-001 gated). For controlled beta, the release-gate.json ritual substitutes for CI enforcement; CI activation is a parallel engineering track.

rejected.title: Cron handler needs explicit distributed lock to prevent overlap
rejected.reason_for_rejection: REFUTED. Cloudflare cron dispatch is per-cron single-instance per trigger; cron handlers are stateless per run; idempotency is enforced via outbox/state columns (template_intent_recovery, client_portal_notification_outbox, retention policy). A distributed lock would add complexity without a proven obligation.

rejected.title: Queue consumers need explicit visibility_timeout_ms
rejected.reason_for_rejection: REFUTED. Both queues use Cloudflare defaults which are adequate for the configured max_batch_size and max_retries. Upload-job queue has per-message idempotency via seenIdempotencyKeys + idempotencyKey field; client-portal queue has per-message lease via conditional UPDATE. No observed need to override default visibility.
